subtopic: Trump Account Investment Options and Contributions
source_evidence: All contributions will be invested in low cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices (such as the S&P 500).
question: How are contributions to Trump Accounts invested, according to the source?
answer: Contributions are invested in low-cost mutual funds or ETFs that track broad U.S. equity indices, such as the S&P 500.
